tool.name: BLAST filter
tool.description: filters BLAST tabular output by percent identity, alignment length and coverage

param.name: input
param.label: BLAST tabular output file
param.help: The column layout must match the format selected below.

param.name: blast_type
param.label: BLAST program used to generate the input
param.help: Determines whether query and subject lengths are treated as amino acids or nucleotides when computing coverage.

param.name: outfmt
param.label: BLAST output format of the input file
param.help: Coverage filtering needs qlen and slen, which the std format does not contain.
param.option: rbhplus - 17 columns (std + qlen slen nident gaps score)
raw - 19 columns (std + qcovs qcovhsp qlen slen nident gaps score)

param.name: covs
param.label: Minimum subject coverage (length / slen)
param.help: Fraction between 0 and 1. Leave at 0 to disable.

validator.message: Subject coverage must be between 0 and 1.

param.name: covq
param.label: Minimum query coverage (length / qlen)
param.help: Fraction between 0 and 1. Leave at 0 to disable.

validator.message: Query coverage must be between 0 and 1.

param.name: covs
param.label: Minimum subject coverage (length / slen)
param.help: Fraction between 0 and 1. Leave at 0 to disable.

validator.message: Subject coverage must be between 0 and 1.

param.name: covq
param.label: Minimum query coverage (length / qlen)
param.help: Fraction between 0 and 1. Leave at 0 to disable.

validator.message: Query coverage must be between 0 and 1.

param.name: pid
param.label: Percent identity filtering method
param.option: Static - fixed percent identity and alignment length cutoffs
Rost 1999 - adaptive cutoff derived from alignment length

param.name: pident
param.label: Percent identity cutoff
param.help: Hits below this identity are discarded.

validator.message: Percent identity must be between 0 and 100.

param.name: length
param.label: Alignment length cutoff
param.help: Hits shorter than this are discarded.

validator.message: Alignment length must be zero or greater.

tool.help:
**What it does**
Filters a BLAST tabular file, keeping only the alignments that pass a percent identity criterion and, where the input format allows it, coverage thresholds on the query and the subject.
-----
**Choosing the input format**
The tool has to know the column layout of the input, because it unpacks each row by position. Pick the entry matching the ``-outfmt`` string you gave BLAST:
std ``-outfmt "6 qseqid sseqid pident length mismatch gapopen qstart qend sstart send evalue bitscore"``
rbhplus ``-outfmt "6 qseqid sseqid pident length mismatch gapopen qstart qend sstart send evalue bitscore qlen slen nident gaps score"``
raw ``-outfmt "6 qseqid sseqid pident length mismatch gapopen qstart qend sstart send evalue bitscore qcovs qcovhsp qlen slen nident gaps score"``
Selecting the wrong one makes the job fail. Coverage options only appear for rbhplus and raw, since std carries no sequence lengths.
-----
**Percent identity filtering**
Static A fixed identity cutoff combined with a minimum alignment length. Suitable when alignment lengths are fairly uniform.
Rost 1999 An adaptive cutoff computed from the alignment length using the twilight zone curve. Short alignments must reach a much higher identity to be kept, which suppresses spurious hits. The alignment length cutoff does not apply in this mode, because length is already built into the threshold (Rost,B. 1999).
-----
**Coverage**
``covs`` is the alignment length divided by the subject length, ``covq`` the alignment length divided by the query length. Both are fractions between 0 and 1. The selected BLAST program decides whether lengths are converted between nucleotides and amino acids before the division.
-----
**Output**
A tabular file with the same columns as the input, containing only the rows that passed every selected criterion.
